proof_roadmap.step: Formal combination: descent lemma plus post-composition lemma.

difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S locally of finite type, an fppf covering {S_i -> S} with base changes f_i and projections g_i, and E in D_QCoh(O_X), the lemma asserts E is m-pseudo-coherent relative to S if and only if each Lg_i^* E is m-pseudo-coherent relative to S_i. The retained proof is written as a two-line formal combination of the chapter's two preceding lemmas: the fppf descent lemma (relative-pseudo-coherent-descends-fppf, which says relative m-pseudo-coherence over S descends/ascends along the fppf cover) and the post-composition lemma (relative-pseudo-coherent-post-compose, comparing relative pseudo-coherence over S and over S_i for the projections). Forward: E relative m-pc over S gives Lg_i^* E relative m-pc over S by the first lemma, then over S_i by the second; backward is the same pair in reverse order. Every named input is a chapter reference, and the author spells out both directions. Retained author proof at lines 20710-20721.
